name: t2helix
description: Persistent recall and pre-action compass for Claude Code. Local-only, SQLite-backed. Compass V2 Action IR.
author: Anthony Vasquez Sr. (templetwo)

scripts.test: node test/smoke.js && node test/regression.js && node test/integration.js && node test/sse-contract.js && node test/import-atlas.js && node test/atlas-acceptance.js && node test/sync-stack.js && node test/action-ir.js && node test/compass-v2.js && node test/codex-adapter.js && node test/grok-adapter.js && node test/compass-consistency.js && node test/compass-normalization.js
scripts.grok:test: T2HELIX_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.claude/plugins/data/t2helix-templetwo-t2helix" npm run grok:init && T2HELIX_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.claude/plugins/data/t2helix-templetwo-t2helix" npm run grok:boot -- "shared chronicle test" && echo 'Grok + Claude now share the same foundational memory surface.'
scripts.codex:init: T2HELIX_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.claude/plugins/data/t2helix-templetwo-t2helix" node -e 'const c=require("./lib/codex-adapter"); const r=c.codexInit(); console.dir(r,{depth:4}); if(!r.ok) process.exitCode=1'
scripts.full-sync: T2HELIX_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.claude/plugins/data/t2helix-templetwo-t2helix" npm run grok:init && echo 'Grok + Claude now share chronicle (same SQLite, same MCP surface)'
